basis.truck: Shares of the 58 human-labeled trucks in the 60 held-out test frames at these cameras: 41 pickup (LDT2 0.50, MDV 0.21), 13 box truck (LHDT2 0.11, MHDT 0.11), 4 tractor-trailer (HHDT 0.07). Every vehicle on a fixed segment drives the same distance, so vehicle share equals VMT share there.
basis.car: Explicit scenario assumption, not measured: the detector does not separate sedans from SUVs and minivans. LDA 0.50, LDT1 0.10, LDT2 0.40. Replace with EMFAC Los Angeles (SC) 2026 VMT shares when available.
basis.bus: Assumption: transit bus (UBUS). Shuttles seen at these cameras are cutaway vans, so this may overstate bus emissions slightly.
basis.ev: Fuel-aggregated factors already include the regional EV share; no extra EV discount.

applies_to: pretrained yolo11n/yolo11s classes car, truck, bus, motorcycle
